basic_info.headline: Engineering Manager & Data Engineer
basic_info.about: Seasoned Data Engineer and Engineering Manager with 20+ years of experience designing, developing, and implementing business applications and data analytics solutions. Proven track record of delivering domain-specific insights and tailored data solutions using custom tools, proprietary frameworks, and open-source technologies across high-tech, insurance, financial, and pharmaceutical industries. Skilled in data architecture, modeling, business analysis, and quality assurance, with a focus on optimizing data pipelines and reporting systems. Visionary leader and mentor adept at fostering high-performing teams, driving innovation, and building strong stakeholder relationships to achieve organizational success.

experience.title: Engineering Manager, Software Engineer - Data
experience.description:
▪Designed and directed a new Data Engineering team of 6-10 Software/Data Engineers from the ground up, focused on optimizing team performance and fostering individual career growth within a fast-paced, data-driven environment.
▪Developed and executed a comprehensive data strategy that aligned with Lyft’s Mapping Organization’s goals and supported the data needs of it’s four divisions, enabling successful delivery of key company offerings.
▪Managed 100+ core data pipelines and workflows for Lyft’s Mapping organization, ensuring 24x7x365 reliability, real-time analytics, and self-service reporting capabilities.
▪Established and maintained strategic alliances with key stakeholders and partner teams, ensuring cross-functional alignment, priority management, and effective communication of progress toward organizational goals.
▪Designed and implemented self-service data tools and observability/monitoring suites, empowering cross functional partners, product engineering, and science teams to meet their data needs and enhance visibility into data and system performance.
▪Mentored and coached team members, facilitating career development and driving productivity and continuous improvement.
▪Optimized team processes and communication, improving developer productivity and collaboration across geographically diverse teams with varying time zones and regulatory requirements.
▪Audited and optimized the company’s Data Engineering interview processes, contributing to Lyft’s recruiting efforts to ensure consistency, conformity and enhanced interviewee experience.

experience.title: Principal Consultant with Clarity Insights on Assignment
experience.description:
Data Engineer

▪ Guided on-site consulting team of six, ensuring team productivity, accountability and performance.
▪ Designed and developed efficient, scalable, and reliable data pipeline processes, leveraging source data analysis and collaboration with data scientists to meet project goals.
▪ Documented data pipeline processes, creating detailed run-books and operations manuals to streamline knowledge sharing and operational efficiency.
▪ Stabilized machine learning (ML) training data pipelines improving general data quality and process reliability, migrated from HiveQL to Spark optimizing processes and data availability, and developed next-generation architecture shifting from ride to ride-segment level granularity enabling more precise analysis and training.
▪ Supported enterprise data engineering GDPR compliance efforts through investigation, quality assurance, cross-team pipeline remediation, and temporary takeover of key systems as part of the KTLO (Keep the Lights On) team ensuring system stability.
